executive_summary: Two parallel renderer stacks exist: (1) the new BaseTuiRenderer/ITuiRenderContext MVVM architecture in Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions, and (2) the high-performance ConsoleEx stack in Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx which lives entirely outside that ecosystem. Ansi and Plain extend BaseTuiRenderer but duplicate ~80% of their event-to-output logic. The minimal-change path is to (a) wrap ConsoleEx in an ITuiRenderContext adapter so it participates in the MVVM ecosystem without rewriting its cell-diff engine or AnsiWriter, and (b) extract the duplicated event formatting shared by Ansi/Plain/ConsoleEx into a single helper.

abstraction_layers.name: Harbor.Abstractions.Tui (legacy)
abstraction_layers.status: Coexists with newer layer; simpler input/slash-command contracts. Not used by ConsoleEx or the BaseTuiRenderer family.

abstraction_layers.name: Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions (canonical)
abstraction_layers.status: The preferred target for unification. Provides view/viewmodel fan-out, placement-driven rendering, and plugin registration.

in_repo_renderers.name: Harbor.Tui.Ansi
in_repo_renderers.context: AnsiRenderContext (internal, writes ANSI escape codes directly to Console)
in_repo_renderers.notes: Simple streaming renderer. Live tokens written directly; status bar/diff via builtin views.

in_repo_renderers.name: Harbor.Tui.Plain
in_repo_renderers.context: PlainRenderContext (internal, writes plain text to TextWriter)
in_repo_renderers.notes: Near-identical structure to AnsiTuiRenderer; same event switch duplicated.

in_repo_renderers.name: Harbor.Tui.Notifications
in_repo_renderers.notes: Non-interactive; fires OS desktop notifications. All Write* methods are no-ops.

in_repo_renderers.name: Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx
in_repo_renderers.context: Owns AnsiWriter, ScreenBuffer, DiffEngine, Cell/CellStyle, PromptBuffer, ComposerController, StreamingMarkdownRenderer, ChatScreenBridge, InlineAgentStreamBridge, ScreenSession
in_repo_renderers.notes: High-performance cell-diff renderer. Must NOT be rewritten. Lives outside BaseTuiRenderer ecosystem.

duplication_inventory.impact: Same switch on MessageStartEvent, MessageUpdateEvent, MessageEndEvent, ToolExecutionStartEvent, CompactionStartedEvent, CompactionCompletedEvent, AgentErrorEvent duplicated with only cosmetic differences (ANSI colors vs plain text).
Identical override suppressing ChatHistory and Input placements.
ReadLineAsync, WriteAsync, WriteLineAsync, ClearAsync, Dispose are one-liners delegating to Context. Can be lifted to BaseTuiRenderer once context supports the needed operations.
Plain and Capture render contexts silently drop colors/styles. Shared base could handle the no-op semantics.

Wide-rune aware width and wrapping exist only in ConsoleEx. The markdown renderer in Terminal.Abstractions (GfmTableFormatter) has its own simpler approach. Shared utilities would benefit all renderers.
High-performance frozen-tail markdown renderer is locked inside ConsoleEx. The simpler GfmTableFormatter in Terminal.Abstractions cannot match its streaming performance.
ConsoleEx uses PackedColor (bit-packed RGB/palette) and StyleAttr (flags). Terminal.Abstractions uses TuiColor (RGB record) and TuiStyle (flags). Conversion helpers needed for adapter.

underutilized_abstractions.name: BaseTuiRenderer
underutilized_abstractions.why_underutilized: ConsoleEx does not inherit from it. Ansi/Plain use it but duplicate event formatting instead of delegating to a shared helper.
underutilized_abstractions.leverage: Make BaseTuiRenderer the single entry point for all non-ConsoleEx renderers; add a virtual FormatLiveEvent hook that ConsoleEx can override.

underutilized_abstractions.name: ITuiRenderContext
underutilized_abstractions.why_underutilized: ConsoleEx cannot implement it because its output model is cell-buffer-based, not stream-based.
underutilized_abstractions.leverage: Add a Flush() overload accepting a byte span (or a FrameBuffer abstraction) so high-performance renderers can batch output without losing the context contract.

underutilized_abstractions.name: CaptureRenderContext
underutilized_abstractions.why_underutilized: Only used in tests. Can serve as the model for a SharedNoOpRenderContext base.
underutilized_abstractions.leverage: Extract a SharedNoOpRenderContext that Capture, Plain, and Notification can all inherit from, reducing per-project context code.

underutilized_abstractions.name: TerminalColorPalette
underutilized_abstractions.why_underutilized: ConsoleEx has its own ChatPalette that projects these tokens into PackedColor. Ansi/Plain hardcode TuiColor values inline.
underutilized_abstractions.leverage: Make TerminalColorPalette the single source of truth; add PackedColor projection helpers so ConsoleEx can reference tokens without re-declaring them.

underutilized_abstractions.name: ViewRegistry / ViewModelRegistry
underutilized_abstractions.why_underutilized: ConsoleEx has its own panel/widget system (ChatTimelinePanel, StatusViewModel) that does not register with ViewRegistry.
underutilized_abstractions.leverage: ConsoleEx can register its native widgets as ITuiView adapters, or the adapter can bridge events to the existing view models.

proposal.strategy: Adapter-based unification: wrap existing renderers rather than rewrite them. Extract shared behavior into BaseTuiRenderer and Terminal.Abstractions. ConsoleEx keeps its entire optimized stack intact.

steps.title: Extract StreamingEventFormatter into Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions
steps.description: Move the event-to-live-output switch from AnsiTuiRenderer and PlainTuiRenderer into a single static helper: StreamingEventFormatter.FormatAsync(AgentEvent, ITuiRenderContext, bool supportsColor). This eliminates the ~80% code duplication between Ansi and Plain. Both renderers call this helper from their RenderAsync overrides.
steps.risk: LOW — pure extraction, no behavior change.

steps.title: Lift trivial ITuiRenderer methods to BaseTuiRenderer
steps.description: Move ReadLineAsync, WriteAsync, WriteLineAsync, ClearAsync into BaseTuiRenderer as virtual methods that delegate to Context (when Context is non-null). Renderers that need custom behavior (ConsoleEx, Notification) override; Ansi/Plain inherit the defaults.
steps.risk: LOW — additive virtual methods with default implementations.

steps.title: Create SharedNoOpRenderContext base in Terminal.Abstractions
steps.description: Extract a base class that implements ITuiRenderContext with no-op cursor/screen methods and Write/WriteLine that delegate to an optional TextWriter. PlainRenderContext and NotificationRenderContext inherit from it, overriding only WriteColored/WriteStyled when needed.
steps.risk: LOW — reduces boilerplate, no behavioral change.

steps.title: Create color conversion helpers between PackedColor and TuiColor
steps.description: Add TuiColor ToTuiColor(this PackedColor) and PackedColor ToPackedColor(this TuiColor) extension methods in Terminal.Abstractions. This lets ConsoleEx consume TuiColor-based APIs without changing its internal PackedColor representation.

steps.title: Create ConsoleExRenderContext adapter implementing ITuiRenderContext
steps.description: Build an adapter that wraps ConsoleEx's native AnsiWriter + ScreenSession (or the higher-level InlineAgentStreamBridge / ChatScreenBridge) and presents an ITuiRenderContext surface. Key design: Write/WriteLine/WriteColored/WriteStyled feed into the AnsiWriter; SetCursorPosition/ClearLine/Clear are no-ops or thin wrappers; Flush triggers EndFrameAsync. This is the critical bridge that lets ConsoleEx participate in BaseTuiRenderer's view/viewmodel fan-out WITHOUT rewriting AnsiWriter, ScreenBuffer, or DiffEngine.
steps.risk: MEDIUM — adapter must faithfully map ITuiRenderContext semantics to ConsoleEx's frame-pipeline model. Needs tests.

steps.title: Create ConsoleExTuiRenderer that extends BaseTuiRenderer
steps.description: Build a ConsoleExTuiRenderer that owns the existing ConsoleEx stack (AnsiWriter, ScreenSession, ChatScreenBridge, etc.) and presents an ITuiRenderContext via the new adapter. It overrides RenderAsync to route events through the existing ChatScreenBridge / InlineAgentStreamBridge, while still participating in BaseTuiRenderer's view registration and placement logic for status-bar and diff-overlay views.
steps.risk: MEDIUM — must ensure the adapter and renderer do not break ConsoleEx's existing frame pacing or cell-diff invariants.

steps.title: Move UnicodeWidth and TextWrap to Terminal.Abstractions
steps.description: Relocate Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/Rendering/UnicodeWidth.cs and TextWrap.cs into Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions/Rendering/. Update ConsoleEx to reference them from the new location. This lets all renderers share the same wide-rune-aware wrapping and width calculations.
steps.risk: LOW — pure relocation with namespace aliases if needed.

steps.title: Add TerminalColorPalette-backed TuiColor constants to Terminal.Abstractions
steps.description: Add a TerminalColorPaletteAdapter or extend TuiColor with named constants (Accent, Success, Warning, Error, Tool, System, User) sourced from Harbor.DesignSystem.TerminalColorPalette. This lets Ansi/Plain/ConsoleEx all render with the same design-token colors without each project re-declaring hex values.

steps.title: Register ConsoleEx in TuiModule and add feature-flag wiring
steps.description: Update TuiModule.AddHarborTui to include a 'consoleex' case (guarded by HARBOR_WITH_CONSOLE_EX if needed). The switch returns ConsoleExTuiRenderer when selected. Default remains 'spectre-tui' or 'ansi' depending on feature flags.

steps.title: Add adapter compliance tests
steps.description: Write tests verifying that ConsoleExRenderContext correctly implements ITuiRenderContext semantics (Write/WriteLine/WriteColored/WriteStyled produce expected AnsiWriter output, Flush calls EndFrameAsync, cursor methods are safe no-ops). Add tests for StreamingEventFormatter to guarantee Ansi/Plain output parity.

out_of_scope: Rewriting ConsoleEx optimizations (AnsiWriter SGR automaton, cell-diff ScreenBuffer/DiffEngine, StreamingMarkdownRenderer frozen-tail algorithm). These are explicitly preserved.
Bringing Spectre/TerminalGui/Termina/RazorConsole source in-tree. They remain external packages implementing ITuiRenderContext.
Merging Harbor.Abstractions.Tui into Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions. The legacy layer can be deprecated separately.
success_criteria: AnsiTuiRenderer and PlainTuiRenderer share 100% of event-to-output logic via StreamingEventFormatter.
ConsoleEx can be selected via HARBOR_TUI=consoleex and participates in BaseTuiRenderer view registration without touching AnsiWriter or DiffEngine.
All existing tests pass; new adapter tests verify ITuiRenderContext contract compliance.
No renderer-specific code leaks into Harbor.Abstractions or Harbor.Terminal.Abstractions beyond the shared formatter, color tokens, and UnicodeWidth/TextWrap.
